detail.longDescription: 🐧 Linux systems engineering note: When deploying long-running background workers on micro instances, always configure `MemoryMax=` and `Restart=always` inside your systemd service unit. Without slice cgroup limits, a single uncontrolled memory spike can trigger the kernel OOM killer and take down your entire node. Defensive system architecture at the OS level saves hours of post-mortem debugging. # linux # sysadmin # devops # foss # opensource # selfhosted # homelab
